subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw add an admin-scoped all-session auth refresh API, and what session/auth state may it invalidate while preserving conversation context?
rationale: The implementation gap is clear, but the safe behavior crosses credential ownership, explicit per-session pins, transcript continuity, Gateway protocol scope, provider routing, and security expectations.

options.title: Add Admin Auth Refresh Contract
options.body: Define a sessions.refreshAuth-style API with all-sessions scope, stale-state ownership rules, authorization semantics, and regression coverage for context preservation and credential invalidation.

options.title: Fold Into Provider Switch
options.body: Make provider/auth switching own the session refresh as one transaction, reducing standalone API surface but tying the behavior to switch workflows.

options.title: Keep Per-Session Reset Only
options.body: Leave current reset behavior unchanged and document per-session recovery, accepting continued multi-channel auth-switch friction.

recommendation.title: Add Admin Auth Refresh Contract
recommendation.body: Define a sessions.refreshAuth-style API with all-sessions scope, stale-state ownership rules, authorization semantics, and regression coverage for context preservation and credential invalidation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined history on Gateway reset semantics and auth-driven CLI session invalidation.
